order_basis: User screenshot: guide, Moon Pond, carving, historic photo, horse-head walls

captions.zh: 宏村文化导览，循着月沼、木雕、旧影与马头墙，感受古村山水、传统工艺和徽派建筑之美
captions.en: Explore Hongcun through Moon Pond, woodcarvings, historic photographs and horse-head gable walls, and discover the beauty of its scenery, traditional crafts and Huizhou architecture.

captions.zh: 宏村，世界文化遗产地，始建于南宋绍兴年间，被誉为“画里乡村”
captions.en: Hongcun, a UNESCO World Heritage Site founded during the Shaoxing era of the Southern Song dynasty, is known as a village in a Chinese painting.

captions.zh: 承志堂徽派木雕，刀工精湛、细节繁复，被誉为“民间故宫”，是本地民间工艺的杰出代表
captions.en: Chengzhi Hall, known as the Folk Forbidden City, showcases intricate Huizhou-style woodcarvings and masterful craftsmanship, making it an outstanding example of local traditional artistry.

captions.zh: 宏村历史老照片，见证古村落百年间的样貌变迁
captions.en: These historic photographs of Hongcun bear witness to a century of changes in the ancient village.

captions.zh: 徽派建筑马头墙与天井结构，青砖黛瓦，既防火又聚气，是江南民居的典型特征
captions.en: With grey bricks and dark roof tiles, the horse-head gable walls and skywells of Huizhou architecture help prevent the spread of fire and gather auspicious qi. They are distinctive features of traditional homes south of the Yangtze River.
